ei.title: Water as a Sequential and Reusable Resource
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: How water is used is unique to the resource. Oil is completely consumed when it is used, especially if it is burned to provide energy. This also means that the amount of oil consumed by one user is not available for someone else. In contrast, much water use is sequential, and it is not often fully consumed by the first user. For example, the water contained in a river may be extracted by many users as it flows from the upper watershed to its eventual end in a floodplain or ocean. Water may be withdrawn from the river by upstream users, through pumping, diversion and other methods of extraction, but there can also be a lot of return flow of water back to the river during upstream use. This return flow to the river is then available for other users further downstream. In fact, some uses of water, such as hydroelectric power generation, transportation and recreation, do not require any withdrawals of surface water. Water for these purposes is neither withdrawn from the source nor consumed.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①completely(부사) ②burning(←burned 과거분사) ③contained(과거분사) ④extracted(과거분사)
det.analysis:
① completely: Oil is completely consumed → 부사가 형용사(consumed) 수식, 적절
② burning: especially if it is burned to provide energy → be동사 뒤 수동태이므로 과거분사 burned가 맞음. burning은 능동진행이라 틀림 ←정답
③ contained: the water contained in a river → 명사 후치 수식 과거분사, 적절
④ extracted: may be extracted → be동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사, 적절
det.tip: be + p.p. = 수동태 / burned(수동) vs burning(능동진행)

det.korean: ①consumed(과거분사) ②sequential(형용사) ③extracted(과거분사) ④availably(←available 형용사)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ①unique(형용사) ②eventual(형용사) ③farther(←further 부사) ④neither(상관접속사)
det.analysis:
① unique: How water is used is unique to the resource → 보어 자리 형용사, 적절
② eventual: its eventual end in a floodplain → 명사 수식 형용사, 적절
③ farther: available for other users further downstream → further는 '더 나아가서'의 의미로 방향/위치 수식에 적절. farther는 물리적 거리만을 가리키므로 '하류 방향으로 더'라는 추상적 위치 맥락에서는 further가 맞음 ←정답
④ neither: is neither withdrawn ... nor consumed → neither A nor B 상관접속사, 적절
det.tip: further(더 나아가서, 추상/방향) vs farther(물리적 거리만). downstream 앞 방향 부사는 further

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①unique(독특한) ②random(무작위의←sequential) ③pumping(펌핑) ④downstream(하류로)
det.analysis:
① unique: 물 사용 방식이 독특하다 → 석유와 대비되는 물의 특이성 맥락에서 적절
② random: much water use is random → 본문은 순차적(sequential) 특성을 설명함. '무작위'는 맥락상 부적절 ←정답
③ pumping: through pumping → 취수 방법 나열에서 적절
④ downstream: other users further downstream → 상류 사용 후 하류로 흘러가는 맥락에서 적절
det.tip: sequential(순차적) ↔ random(무작위) — 물 사용은 순서가 있음

In fact, some uses of water, such as hydroelectric power generation, transportation and recreation, do not require any withdrawals of surface water. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ①available(이용 가능한) ②extracted(추출된) ③return(환류) ④deposited(퇴적된←withdrawn)
det.analysis:
① available: not available for someone else → 이용 불가 맥락에서 적절

② extracted: may be extracted by many users → 많은 사용자가 취수한다는 맥락에서 적절

③ return: return flow of water back to the river → 강으로 되돌아오는 흐름이므로 적절

④ deposited: neither deposited from the source nor consumed → 원문은 withdrawn(취수된). '퇴적되는' 것이 아니라 '취수되는' 것이므로 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: withdrawn(취수된) ↔ deposited(퇴적/예치된)

det.korean: 물 사용 방식이 자원에 있어 독특함
det.analysis:

questions.passage: How water is used is unique to the resource. Oil is ①<u>completely</u> consumed when it is used, especially if it is burned to provide energy. This also means that the amount of oil consumed by one user is not available for someone else. In contrast, much water use is ②<u>simultaneous</u>, and it is not often fully consumed by the first user. For example, the water contained in a river may be extracted by many users as it flows from the upper watershed to its eventual end in a floodplain or ocean. Water may be withdrawn from the river by upstream users, through pumping, diversion and other methods of extraction, but there can also be a lot of ③<u>return</u> flow of water back to the river during upstream use. This return flow to the river is then available for other users further downstream. In fact, some uses of water, such as hydroelectric power generation, transportation and recreation, do not require any withdrawals of surface water. Water for these purposes is ④<u>neither</u> withdrawn from the source nor consumed.
questions.stem: 다음 ①~④ 중, 원문의 내용과 다른 것은?

det.korean: ② simultaneous → sequential 변형
det.analysis:
① completely: Oil is completely consumed → 원문 그대로, 일치
② simultaneous: much water use is simultaneous → 원문은 sequential(순차적). simultaneous(동시적)로 변형 ←정답
③ return: return flow of water back to the river → 원문 그대로, 일치
④ neither: is neither withdrawn from the source nor consumed → 원문 그대로, 일치
det.tip: sequential(순차적) → simultaneous(동시적) 의미 정반대 변형
